note: One unbroken line draws a Lissajous bouquet, holds, then retraces itself away. Drag to change the ratio.

title: Six Twenty Five
note: Six hundred twenty five tiles scramble, then solve in a ripple from the center. Drag to scramble a patch.

title: Pentagon Swarm
note: Ninety particles stream around a pentagon that snaps inside out into its star and back. Drag to swirl the swarm.

title: Spirograph Knot
note: A hypotrochoid draws itself in ink, then a second ratio lays indigo lace over its gray ghost. Drag to shift the pen.

title: Egg Trace
note: A parametric egg of 1,200 points on stitched rings builds, rotates and dissolves. Drag to bend the egg.

title: Sonic Lumina
note: A field of two-color diagonal flags; a traveling band flips the flags it crosses. Drag to send a wave.

title: Chromatic Scale
note: Twelve tiles, one per semitone, each a two-color split; the sounding tile swaps its colors as the playhead passes. Drag to scrub.

title: Intersecting Colour
note: Four horizontal and four vertical bands cross on bone, their overlaps snapping to flat mixed hues. Drag a band.

title: Rhythm and Colour
note: Concentric segmented rings whose colors march outward on the beat while the whole stack slowly turns. Drag to turn.

title: Chromesthetic Grid
note: A grid of arc-split color modules held apart by a black staff band; a retune wave recolors each module in turn. Drag to retune.

title: Mandelbulb Orbit
note: A ray-marched Mandelbulb on a slow closed orbit, bone lit with one cyan rim. Drag to orbit.

title: Generation 65
note: Six blob creatures crawl, and every ten seconds the best mover breeds the next generation. Drag to nudge them.

title: Halftone Print
note: A live flow field printed as halftone dots, ink on paper. Drag to stir.

title: Pigment Water
note: Gray-Scott pigment blooms in red, amber and teal, split by black seams. Drag to stir in pigment.

title: Voronoi Drift
note: Fibonacci sphere Voronoi cells; the amber pentagons and cyan heptagons wander as the count breathes. Drag to spin.

title: Thirty Seconds
note: Seven Lissajous points, their trails fading over exactly thirty seconds. Drag to scrub time.

title: Color Break
note: Five white elliptical loops; only the parts inside the invisible zone turn red. Drag to move the break.

title: Wall of Light
note: Three beams of light sweeping a dark wall, brightening where they cross. Drag to shift the light.

title: Katalog 217D
note: Fourteen tracks lit by a seeded binary string, one in acid cyan. Drag to scrub the phase.

title: Light Orbit
note: Three great circles of light turning on a black sphere. Drag to orbit.

title: Moire Rings
note: Two dot-ring fields turning against each other; the interference is the picture. Drag to shift the phase.

title: Pendulum Web
note: A double pendulum weaving a fading web, deterministic to the step. Drag to set the release.

title: Thirty-Two Words
note: All 32 five-lamp words, lit in binary counting order. Drag to count.

title: Fourteen Paths
note: All 14 Dyck staircases that never fall below their start. Drag to choose a path.

title: Twenty-Four Orders
note: All 24 orders of four colored dots, one adjacent swap per beat. Drag to scrub the order.

title: Fifteen Chords
note: All 15 ways to pair six points on a circle, in flat neon. Drag to move the wave.

title: Twelve Cells
note: All 12 pentominoes, assembling themselves into a 6 by 10 rectangle. Drag to scrub the assembly.

title: Ten Ways In
note: All 10 ways to pair four dots, visited one panel at a time. Drag to move the visit.

title: Sixteen Trees
note: All 16 spanning trees of four dots, swept one panel at a time. Drag to move the sweep.

title: Eleven Nets
note: All 11 nets of a cube; the hero folds itself into a box. Drag to fold.

title: Maze
note: A perfect maze, carved by rule, its one solution traced in red. Click for another maze.

title: Eclipse
note: Rings whose center drifts as they grow, bunching on one side. Click for another eclipse.

title: Braids
note: Three strands, one of them red, woven over and under down the page. Click for another braids.

title: Moons
note: A 9 by 9 calendar of moon phases under one sun. Click for another moons.

title: Fan
note: Lines from one bright corner, cut into nested gold-banded frames. Click for another fan.

title: Interference
note: Two straight waves multiply across a dot grid, breaking it into islands. Click for another interference.

title: Spiral
note: One spiral walked by arc length, stitched in capsules that lengthen outward. Click for another spiral.

title: Wedge
note: Stipple thrown and rejected by a gradient: solid at one corner, gone at the other. Click for another wedge.

title: Bricks
note: A stretcher-bond wall in outline, one red brick hiding in every row. Click for another bricks.

title: Ticks
note: Rings of ticks breathing at different rates; the longest tick of each ring is gold. Click for another ticks.

title: Harmonograph
note: Two decaying pendulums draw one line that settles as it goes. Click for another harmonograph.

title: Stitch
note: Cross-stitches gather into a continent where a quiet field runs high. Click for another stitch.

title: Lissajous
note: A closed orbit figure drawn in dots instead of a line. Click for another lissajous.

title: Weave
note: Warp and weft capsules alternate, with faults where the parity flips. Click for another weave.

title: Phyllotaxis
note: A sunflower head in white and gold: the golden angle, nothing else. Click for another phyllotaxis.

title: Modules
note: One primitive per filled module on a mostly empty Bauhaus grid. Click for another modules.

title: Armature
note: Two wireframe solids turn against each other in neon. Click for a new form.

title: Pack
note: Circles admitted largest first, only where nothing overlaps. Click for another pack.

title: Globe
note: An icosphere wireframe with torn edges and a few in gold. Click for another globe.

title: Halftone
note: Dot rings swell and shrink by one radial cosine, in indigo. Click for another halftone.

title: Drift
note: 350 capsules ride three breathing vortices, laying neon trails. Click for a new current.

title: Shimmer
note: Dashed rings interfere until the target vibrates; one ring is red. Click for another shimmer.

title: Rain
note: Capsule rain on cream, stretched and tinted by two quiet fields. Click for another rain.

title: Vanishing
note: A floor of dots receding to one off-center point. Click for another vanishing.

title: Scanline
note: A disc of green scanlines, each exactly as long as its chord. Click for another scanline.

title: Contours
note: Sixty lines share one travelling wave on paper white. Click for another contours.

title: Orbits
note: Chords inside three rings fake the circles they never draw. Click for another orbits.

title: Desordres
note: A square grid that loses its composure corner by corner. Click for another desordres.

title: Orb
note: A sphere of dots, sized and tinted by how they face you. Click for another orb.

title: Vortex
note: Capsules ride a vortex field, colored by their speed. Click for another vortex.

title: Pinwheel Quilt
note: Ink pinwheels on a warped lattice, after a hand-drawn quilt. A seamless loop; double-tap re-sews it.

title: Pinwheel Quilt II
note: Closer to the hand-drawn original: portrait lattice, stronger swirl, wilder warp. A seamless loop; double-tap re-sews it.

title: Linkwork
note: After the forged wall sculpture: interlocking bronze and blackened-steel links, hand-hammered, each at its own depth. A slow light sweep crosses the metal; double-tap re-forges it.

title: Linkwork II
note: Second study after the forged wall sculpture: a denser, more tangled cluster of bronze and blackened-steel links. A slow light sweep crosses the metal; double-tap re-forges it.
